description: Watchman at the ward gate, fourth ward east of the West Market. Sixties. Sits all day out of the wind with a brazier he considers his personal property.
knows: that he knocked at the Geng gate at the second drum and was refused
that he is not a harmless confused old man, and let him back into the ward anyway
that his own heart is failing, because Xu Ping told him plainly
last_seen: his brazier, through the night, after the second drum
name: Tang
not_knows: that Xu Ping knelt at the Geng east wall and put his hands in the gutter
owes_owed: Xu Ping told him what the swelling in his ankles means and what to do about it, and took nothing for it

promises.what: if it comes to pain at the end, Xu Ping will see that it does not hurt

toward_player: Warm, and now uneasy with it. Has worked out that helping means informing on a household in his own ward, and said so out loud. Will still talk. Will not be asked to watch and report.
voice: Circles back to his own feet from any subject in under three sentences.
